# Newmara

Newmara is a long term investment company that buys, operates and grows established businesses and acquires, develops and owns real estate.

## Three ways business owners can work with Newmara
1. Sell Your Business — Newmara can buy the entire company and become its long term owner and operator.
2. Transition Over Time — an owner can agree on a timeframe to gradually transfer ownership and responsibilities to Newmara.
3. Partner for Growth — an owner can keep ownership and stay involved while Newmara provides capital and hands on help with sales, marketing, customer acquisition, operations, technology and acquisitions.

## Business focus
- Construction and infrastructure: asphalt, paving, concrete, aggregates, excavation, site development, utilities, roadwork and infrastructure services.
- Trades and home services.
- Manufacturing and industrial businesses.
- Property related businesses.

## Real estate
Newmara also acquires, develops, owns and improves real estate for the long term.

## Local markets
Newmara actively builds relationships with business owners across Volusia County and Flagler County, including Daytona Beach, Ormond Beach, Port Orange, New Smyrna Beach, DeLand, Deltona, DeBary, Edgewater, Holly Hill, Orange City, South Daytona, Palm Coast, Bunnell, Flagler Beach and surrounding communities. This local focus does not limit Newmara to these markets.
